It ships alacritty_terminal 0.26.0 (alacritty/Cargo.toml:3,13-15 at tag v0.17.0, file SHA256 ccbe547a224e9a13d3a08e6cd24f2c1fd1c92c28e02eda9324c14892244238ff), the crate this App backend is built from (engine receipt: upstreamCrate alacritty_terminal 0.26.0, crate SHA256 bda177466b9524d59f1b12f0dd30b68696788e9992a7e959021c4a0ed96fcf59), and that crate's locked VTE 0.15.0 (crate SHA256 a5924018406ce0063cd67f8e008104968b74b563ee1b85dde3ed1f7cb87d3dbd) dispatches only OSC 0/2, 4, 8, 10-12, 22, 50, 52, 104 and 110-112: ansi.rs:1329-1525 sends every other code to `_ => unhandled(params)` at :1523, whose Debug line at :1341 never reaches the handler. alacritty_terminal 0.26.0 has no prompt-mark code at all - impl Handler for Term (src/term/mod.rs:1059) declares no OSC 133/633 method, and semantic_escape_chars there is selection word separators - and Alacritty's own escape table (extra/man/alacritty-escapes.7.scd:215-255 at the same tag, file SHA256 bf0e0fdadcb3be999e810ba07794f305f8ebb749491c872f2bf84970fa13da44) lists no 133 or 633.

This is a source read of an absent feature, not a silent runtime probe. It ships alacritty_terminal 0.26.0 (alacritty/Cargo.toml:3,13-15 at tag v0.17.0, file SHA256 ccbe547a224e9a13d3a08e6cd24f2c1fd1c92c28e02eda9324c14892244238ff), the crate this App backend is built from (engine receipt: upstreamCrate alacritty_terminal 0.26.0, crate SHA256 bda177466b9524d59f1b12f0dd30b68696788e9992a7e959021c4a0ed96fcf59), and that crate's locked VTE 0.15.0 (crate SHA256 a5924018406ce0063cd67f8e008104968b74b563ee1b85dde3ed1f7cb87d3dbd) dispatches only OSC 0/2, 4, 8, 10-12, 22, 50, 52, 104 and 110-112: ansi.rs:1329-1525 sends every other code to `_ => unhandled(params)` at :1523, whose Debug line at :1341 never reaches the handler. alacritty_terminal 0.26.0 has no prompt-mark code at all - impl Handler for Term (src/term/mod.rs:1059) declares no OSC 133/633 method, and semantic_escape_chars there is selection word separators - and Alacritty's own escape table (extra/man/alacritty-escapes.7.scd:215-255 at the same tag, file SHA256 bf0e0fdadcb3be999e810ba07794f305f8ebb749491c872f2bf84970fa13da44) lists no 133 or 633.
